output.summary: Wire default Pi output-file collection into host one-shot runs.

approvedRows.question: Should runRuntimeHostOnce use the project-local Pi output-file collector when no custom completion collector is supplied?
approvedRows.currentState: runRuntimeHostOnce required a custom completion collector, so the real process-session path from worker output file to implementation preview was not exercised by default.
approvedRows.desiredState: runRuntimeHostOnce defaults to reading worker output files, while still allowing an injected custom collector.
approvedRows.rationale: Supervised real-worker debugging should test session spawn, project-local output capture, output-file collection, worker normalization, and implementation preview as one path.
approvedRows.userImpact: Users get safer runtime dogfooding because a missing custom collector no longer blocks the persisted Pi worker output path.
approvedRows.maintainerImpact: Maintainers get a targeted host-runner regression that uses createPiProcessSessionFactory and the default output-file collector.
approvedRows.recommendationRationale: Evidence supports this intention as valuable and safe to plan.
